description: This file defines the 'Document' class which extends 'File' and manages document entities within the SuiteCRM system, including saving, retrieving metadata, list view rendering, and relationship handling.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents a document entity, handling its properties, saving to database, and related metadata management within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Document object, setting up custom fields and security settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides parent save to include document revision and related entity management.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the document name as its summary representation.

methods.name: is_authenticated
methods.description: Checks if the document instance is authenticated.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills in extra list view fields for the document.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail fields such as revision info and file URLs.

methods.name: list_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Parses additional sections in list view, currently a placeholder.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to export document data with custom join conditions.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns an array of document data for list views.

methods.name: mark_relationships_deleted
methods.description: Deletes related revision relationships and associated files.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Specifies the interfaces this bean implements (ACL and FILE).

methods.name: get_document_name
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the document name by document ID.
